name: Catchy Tune
text:
You create a tune so catchy your foes can't help but dance along. Attempt a Performance check check and compare it to the Will DCs of all enemies in a 30-foot emanation.

---
Critical Success The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds and is Off-Guard, both until the start of your next turn.

Success The creature takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn.

Failure The creature is unaffected.

Critical Failure The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Catchy Tune for 1 hour.
